zh.text: 加州大学洛杉矶分校（UCLA）是一所位于美国加利福尼亚州洛杉矶西木区的公立研究型大学。其学术渊源可追溯至1881年成立的师范学校，1919年正式成为加州大学系统的一部分。学校设有文理学院及十二所专业学院，涵盖艺术、工程、医学、法律等多个学科领域。UCLA学生运动员以“棕熊”队名参加大十联盟比赛，并在历届奥运会中持续获得奖牌。

en.text: The University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) is a public land-grant research university located in the Westwood neighborhood of Los Angeles, California. Its academic roots date back to 1881 as a normal school, and it became part of the University of California system in 1919. The university is organized into the College of Letters and Science and twelve professional schools, offering degree programs in disciplines such as arts, engineering, medicine, and law. UCLA student-athletes compete as the Bruins in the Big Ten Conference and have a long history of participation in the Olympic Games.
